subject: Re: MEETING OF THE COUNCIL - 22 OCTOBER AT 7.00PM
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Mr Egan,

Thank you for the agenda and Zoom link. Ahead of the 22 October meeting I would like to flag two items for the public record, both tied to the Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr material at https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/wayback/go/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fgreathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com%26source%3Dgmail%26ust%3D1792226701788000%26sa%3DE.

First, my FOI to the Council (treated as such in your reply of 11 October) and the internal review request of 13 October remain open. I am not asking the Council to pre-judge them at the meeting; I simply ask that the review outcome or a firm date be communicated before or at the meeting so that public participation is not conducted under a section 12 refusal that has not been reviewed.

Second, I have placed preservation requests with The National Archives, HM Land Registry, the MOD, South Wales Police and others concerning 1988 records. If the Council holds any planning files, section 52/106 instruments or correspondence from 1988-1992 relating to planning refs 89/01396/OUT and 92/00671/RES, I would be grateful for confirmation that they are being retained pending those wider enquiries.

I will participate through the public participation slot only.

Title and chronology index: https://cedwyn.bucklerfamily.estate/wayback/go/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fdartboard.bucklerfamily.estate%26source%3Dgmail%26ust%3D1792226701788000%26sa%3DE

Sion Buckler
